title: Reapplication must prove that managed state is still owned
environment: Bounded Blender texture bindings. Unrelated nodes remain untouched; these results do not establish exact export fidelity.
goal: Re-resolve previously bound material textures without losing user edits.
approach: Historical failed assumption: A saved BOUND status was treated as permission to reapply a provider.
what_worked: Historical correction: Record the scoped image/link signature when applying a binding. Preserve mismatches with an explicit user-edit status; leave legacy receipt-free bindings unverified. Verification reported by the source: Pre-fix image/link sequences failed. Corrected edit, provider-loss/readdition, and save/reopen controls passed; forcing signature acceptance made the focused regression fail. An unedited owned binding still cleared on provider loss.
what_failed: Historical observed failure: Resolve replaced a user-selected image; a changed node link was rewired after save/reopen.
why: Confirmed: no applied-state comparison distinguished automation-owned state from subsequent user edits.
improved_method: Before replaying managed state, compare it with the exact state automation installed. Preserve unproven ownership rather than upgrading it by assumption.
when_to_use: Bounded Blender texture bindings. Unrelated nodes remain untouched; these results do not establish exact export fidelity.
when_not_to_use: Unrelated nodes remain untouched; these results do not establish exact export fidelity.
known_limitations: This is an independently curated generalization of an earlier recorded failure. No source-side experiment was rerun during this registration; observation_date is the 2026-10-09 knowledge-review date, not the incident date. Applicability and root-cause claims remain limited to the source-reported conditions.
